interpretations_of_open_clauses.ABS_close_to_QMARK: the runbook says 'ABS 与 QMARK 接近' without a number: fixed as |T(ABS) - T(QMARK)| <= 0.10 (the M3 tolerance)
interpretations_of_open_clauses.advantage_concentrated_in_multiple_dual_: the runbook says 'B2 的优势集中在多个双目标 cell' without a number: fixed as B2 leads QMARK by >= 0.20 in BOTH dual-goal cells (BUF_T+BUF_S, IN_S+BUF_T) while the mean B2 lead in the two single-goal cells (IN_S, BUF_T) is <= 0.10
interpretations_of_open_clauses.pooling: with several seeds T and C are means over seeds of the per-seed rates over the 32 final cases; B2 and ABS use the matched seeds of QMARK
interpretations_of_open_clauses.strong_and_failed: the runbook says 'B2/ABS 保持强结果' / '明显失效' without a number: strong = T >= 0.70, failed = T < 0.50 (both B2 and ABS)

rules.seed_release: QMARK seed1 only if seed0 is ID-qualified and the seed0 classification is M4; seed2 only if the seed0/1 pooled classification is M4; stop at the first non-M4 class; after seed2 a pooled M4 is MECHANISM_INCONCLUSIVE
